sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nemetius belongs to the gods of continental Celtic worship. His Latinized name, by its form, convinced scholars that he was divine. Worship of Nemetius was confined to a single place along the western edge of the Rhine. His name links to the term the Celts used for sacred grove. The same word root appears in Nemeton and Nemetona.

okr.objective: Nemetius is a Continental Celtic god tied to the sacred grove.
